layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/at/erstebank/README.md and example.png (George, the Erste group internet bank that Česká spořitelna also runs: the CSV export is UTF-16LE, its fields are chosen and ordered in the export dialog, separator ";" by default, a quote-character option, sort by booking date) with default.json (semicolon, d.m.Y, header row)
https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/develop/bank2ynab/data/bank2ynab.conf [CZ Ceska Sporitelna] (the older TH_<from>-<to>.csv export, semicolon)
notes: George (Česká spořitelna) "Export pohybů" as CSV. UTF-16 little-endian with a BOM, CRLF, semicolon-separated, every field double-quoted (the quote option), dates DD.MM.YYYY, Částka signed with a comma decimal (no thousands mark assumed), a Měna column, newest first (sorted by booking date). The encoding, separator and date form follow the Erste/BCR George exports; the Czech column names and which columns are on by default are not confirmed (the user picks them). Expected dates are "Datum zaúčtování".
